summary: Version 0.8.0 is live at https://antipo.watch and reads Form S-1/A, Amendment No. 3, filed 2026-11-17: same price range, shares offered and symbol; Nasdaq approved the listing; the lock-up table now gives Class A, Class N and a total, and UNLOCK shows the total. Amendment No. 2 is kept in data/facts/history/; the overview names the filing and its date with a link 'what changed', and a HISTORY panel lists the 21 figures that changed (the listing, 20 lock-up steps, folded), each side opening its own filing's passage. The owner saw the screenshots and asked to fold the steps, then deploy. 14 real-browser tests pass against the live site.
delivered: extract.py reads both amendments' wordings (listing, 2026 Plan reserve, one-column or three-column lock-up table), takes the amendment number from the cover, and records the listing status as a fact.
data/facts/s1a3.json current; data/facts/history/s1a2.json re-extracted by the same code.
Facts.filing and Facts.history replace the document name in code; versions.py compares filings in a row.
Overview link 'what changed'; HISTORY panel (key h) with the lock-up steps folded; UNLOCK note on Class A and Class N.
edgar.newer_than ignores filings older than the one the page reads (bug found while switching).
CHANGELOG 0.8.0, STATUS, D-036, ARCHITECTURE (diagram), CLAUDE.md (how to add a filing), devlog loop-008.
decisions: Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-17: move to Amendment No. 3; versioning with a date at the top instead of wiping; fold the lock-up steps; deploy.
Proposed (D-036): earlier filings in data/facts/history/, compared fact by fact at rendering, each side under its own id and source; document facts left out.
Revisited from the mission: the Class A and Class N columns are not separate facts; each step's source card quotes the whole row, and the step is the filing's total.
Deferred: stock-based compensation estimates and Amazon/Google holdings from Amendment No. 3.
